info.title: Hamba Email API
info.description: API for Hamba - a keyboard-driven email client. Supports Gmail, Microsoft, Yahoo OAuth and IMAP/SMTP providers.

reply_to_id.description: ID of email being replied to

is_default.description: Whether this is the default signature

reply_to_id.description: ID of email being replied to

get.description: Returns the API health status
Returns aggregated and recent performance metrics for monitoring
Returns detailed health information including memory usage, metrics, and error counts
Returns recent errors for debugging. Useful for monitoring and alerting.
Redirects user to Google OAuth consent screen for Gmail account authentication
Handles the OAuth callback from Google, exchanges code for tokens, and creates/updates account
Redirects user to Microsoft OAuth consent screen for Outlook/Office365 account authentication
Handles the OAuth callback from Microsoft, exchanges code for tokens, and creates/updates account
Redirects user to Yahoo OAuth consent screen for Yahoo Mail account authentication
Handles the OAuth callback from Yahoo, exchanges code for tokens, and creates/updates account
Returns all configured email accounts with unread counts and token status. Sensitive credentials are excluded.

post.description: Creates a new IMAP/SMTP email account. Validates credentials before saving.

get.description: Checks if the account's OAuth token is valid and whether re-authentication is needed
Returns account details excluding sensitive credentials

put.description: Updates account display name, sync frequency (30s-3600s range), and sync settings

initialSyncLimit.description: Number of messages for initial sync (default 100)

syncAllMail.description: Whether to continue syncing all mail in background after initial sync

delete.description: Permanently deletes an email account and all associated data

post.description: Refreshes expired OAuth tokens for Gmail, Microsoft, or Yahoo accounts

get.description: Returns all drafts for the specified account

post.description: Creates a new draft or updates an existing one (upsert). Auto-save uses this endpoint.

replyToId.description: ID of email being replied to

get.description: Returns a single draft by its ID

delete.description: Deletes a draft locally and from the server if synced

post.description: Synchronizes drafts from the email provider (Gmail, Microsoft, etc.) to local database

get.description: Returns all labels (both user-created and system/Gmail labels) for the specified account

post.description: Creates a new user label with optional color

get.description: Returns a single label by its ID

put.description: Updates a label's name or color

delete.description: Permanently deletes a label (also removes it from all emails)

get.description: Returns all emails that have the specified label applied

200.description: List of emails with this label

get.description: Returns the number of emails that have the specified label

count.description: Number of emails with this label

post.description: Applies a label to an email

delete.description: Removes a label from an email

get.description: Returns all labels applied to a specific email
Returns all snippets for the specified account

post.description: Creates a new text snippet with a shortcut trigger. Type ;shortcut in compose to expand.

get.description: Returns a single snippet by its ID

put.description: Updates an existing snippet's name, shortcut, or content

get.description: Finds a snippet by its shortcut trigger (e.g., 'thanks' for ';thanks')

200.description: Snippet details or null if not found

get.description: Returns all contacts for the specified account, sorted by last contacted date

post.description: Manually adds a new contact or updates an existing one (upsert by email)

get.description: Search contacts by name or email. Returns recent contacts if no query provided.

post.description: Extracts contacts from existing emails (from, to, cc fields) and adds them to the contacts list

200.description: Success or error with count of contacts added

get.description: Returns whether AI features are configured (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is set)

post.description: Uses Claude AI to generate email content based on a prompt. Supports composing new emails or replying to existing ones.
Uses Claude AI to generate a 2-3 sentence summary of an email. Summaries are cached.
Uses Claude AI to generate 3 contextual reply suggestions for an email (similar to Gmail smart replies)

emailId.description: Email UUID to generate replies for

get.description: Returns all email signatures for the specified account

post.description: Creates a new email signature. Optionally set as default for the account.

get.description: Returns a single signature by its ID

put.description: Updates an existing signature's name, content, or HTML flag

get.description: Returns the default signature for an account, or null if none set

post.description: Sets this signature as the default for its account. Clears any previous default.

delete.description: Removes the default signature setting for the account

get.description: Returns the status of IMAP IDLE connections for real-time email notifications
